Name: Pau's Rose Gold Tools
Author: suzukiPC
Description:
[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/how-to-install2.png[/img]

1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
2) Download the file and unzip it; extract it into your Mods folder

﻿[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/features.png[/img]

﻿1) Retextures the tools in different materials;
﻿✨ Basic tools -> Stone tools
﻿✨ Copper tools -> Tarnished Brass tools
﻿✨ Steel tools -> Titanium tools
﻿✨ Gold tools -> White Gold tools
﻿✨ Iridium tools -> Rose Gold tools

2) Toggleable skins located in [b]Generic Mod Config[/b] Menu :)
﻿✨ Whole tier sets can be turned on and off for when you prefer base game or a different mod
﻿✨ The sparkles for Rose Gold can be turned off and on
﻿✨ Advanced Iridium Rod can be switched to Advanced Rose Gold Rod and vice versa 

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/shown-mods.png[/img]
